derivation: from G303 (ἀνά) and a form of the alternate of G138 (αἱρέομαι);
def: properly, to use up, i.e. destroy

occurrences.text: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?
But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
